# The Radicals

Some Returner cells favor forcing a permanent mass passage instead of waiting for a safe individual-return procedure. Their motives include grief, impatience, mistrust of V and hunger for prestige. Wanting to go home is not itself radicalism; exposing other people to an uncontrolled operation is the dividing act.

The Glasshouse operator Dain and Nexus engineer Halvek are authored participants in that research network. Edda sponsors early work believing assurances of isolation; after receiving evidence she can stop, help repair the damage, or knowingly persist. Introduce surviving people's roles through actual records and meetings, not an unlimited supply of replacement conspirators.

Cells can surrender, split, testify or join supervised work. No unavoidable last-minute betrayal cancels an earned agreement. Their bypasses accelerate the wound's failures but did not create the old Rift and are not responsible for every natural arrival.
